# Polaris Teen Center

> Polaris Teen Center specializes in evidence-based mental health treatment for adolescents, featuring advanced therapeutic approaches including neurofeedback and trauma-focused interventions.

Located in Los Angeles, Polaris Teen Center provides comprehensive mental health services for teens struggling with personality disorders, emotional regulation, and trauma. The center combines traditional psychotherapy with innovative neurofeedback technology and specialized trauma treatment models.

## Key Topics

- Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD)
- Personality Disorders in Teens
- Neurofeedback Therapy
- EEG Brain Activity Monitoring
- Post Induction Therapy (PIT)
- Childhood Trauma Treatment
- Cluster A & B Personality Disorders
- Adolescent Mental Health
- Teen Emotional Regulation
- Psychotherapy Techniques
- Clinical Psychology
- Los Angeles Teen Mental Health

## Therapeutic Approaches & Treatment Models

- [Post Induction Therapy for Childhood Trauma](https://polaristeen.com/post-induction-therapy): Post Induction Therapy model for treating childhood trauma in adolescents
- [Neurofeedback Therapy](https://polaristeen.com/neurofeedback): Overview of neurofeedback therapy using EEG for teen mental health treatment

## Personality Disorders in Adolescents

- [Emerging Personality Disorders in Teens](https://polaristeen.com/emerging-personality-disorders-los-angeles): Guide to personality disorders in teens including BPD and treatment options
